interpretation: ETW CPU samples use CoreCLR with tiering disabled and are restricted to the recorded compilation intervals and target process. Stage counts include compiler frames and are not elapsed-time or NativeAOT shares. Exclusive and compiler-charge lists contain the top 100 entries, so omitted methods must not be treated as zero. NativeAOT method sizes come from complete compiler map files.
